qualifier: both biosynthesis and lysosomal degradation (mucopolysaccharidoses)
name: Glycosaminoglycan synthesis and degradation with protein O-glycosylation
rationale: Members cover proteoglycan/GAG chain synthesis, O-mannosyl/O-fucosyl/O-glucosyl protein glycosylation and the lysosomal GAG degradation of mucopolysaccharidoses; the degradation arm separates it from a biosynthesis-only neighbour and the synthesis arm from lysosomal glycoside-catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: triglyceride and phosphatidylcholine (CDP-choline) branches
name: Phosphatidic acid-derived triglyceride and phosphatidylcholine synthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of PA, DAG/MAG, TAG and PC via CDP-choline; PC synthesis and its regulation distinguish it from neighbours focused on phospholipid remodelling, hydrolysis or triglyceride catabolism and lipid droplets.

qualifier: kinesin motors and microtubule depolymerization
name: Kinesin-mediated neuronal vesicle and receptor transport
rationale: Members describe motor-driven transport of synaptic and dense core vesicles and receptor complexes in axons and dendrites; kinesins and microtubule depolymerization distinguish it from neighbours about mitochondrial/organelle transport or tubulin modification.

qualifier: severing, barbed-end capping and depolymerization
name: Regulation of actin filament turnover by severing and capping
rationale: All members regulate actin filament assembly and disassembly (severing, capping, depolymerization, Arp2/3 inhibition, ruffle polymerization), whereas neighbours concern lamellipodia, filopodia, bundling or crosslinking.

qualifier: glycosyltransferase steps building O-glycans, N-glycan antennae, GAG chains and blood-group antigens
name: Glycosyltransferase-mediated protein glycan and proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: Members are glycan-building reactions on proteins (GAG chains, O-GalNAc/O-Man/O-Fuc glycans, N-glycan maturation, fucosylation, sialylation, ABO/Lewis antigens); neighbours instead cover nucleotide-sugar supply/transport or glycosphingolipid synthesis.

qualifier: phenylalanine-tyrosine (with BH4), histidine, threonine and proline
name: Phenylalanine, tyrosine, histidine, threonine and proline catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolism dominated by aromatic, histidine, threonine, glycine and proline catabolism plus the BH4 cofactor for phenylalanine hydroxylation; neighbours concern serine, sulfur amino acids, vitamin B6 or molybdenum cofactor.

qualifier: second heart field, outflow tract and great arteries
name: Second heart field, outflow tract and great artery morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic heart development, specifically second heart field, cardiac neural crest, outflow tract septation and pharyngeal/pulmonary/coronary arteries, which neighbours focused on chambers, valves, septa or conduction lack.

qualifier: linked to integrin cell adhesion and platelet degranulation
name: Metalloproteinase and plasmin matrix proteolysis regulating cell adhesion
rationale: Members cover collagen/elastin degradation, MMP activation and plasminogen-driven fibrinolysis, plus cell and integrin adhesion and platelet degranulation that distinguish it from contact-activation and hyaluronan-degradation neighbours.

qualifier: inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing
name: Inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing and inflammatory cytokine regulation
rationale: All members regulate pro-inflammatory cytokine production and TLR/TNF/IL-1 signalling, and the NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1 precursor processing members distinguish it from TLR-focused neighbours.

qualifier: positive regulation of TLR3 and TLR4 signalling
name: Toll-like receptor 3/4-driven proinflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members are positive regulation of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production together with enhanced TLR3/TLR4 signalling, distinguishing it from inflammasome, TRIF-pathway mechanics and LPS-detection neighbours.

qualifier: mesonephric duct and ureteric bud elongation
name: Mesonephric duct and ureteric bud morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe nephric/mesonephric duct formation, ureteric bud elongation and ureter morphogenesis, whereas neighbours emphasise bud induction, branching or kidney size control.

qualifier: fructose 2,6-bisphosphate control and lactate fermentation
name: Glycolytic flux to lactate regulated by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate
rationale: Members are glycolysis (hexokinase, fructose bisphosphates, lactate fermentation) and its regulation, distinct from gluconeogenesis, creatine/oxygen and HIF/FOXO neighbours.

qualifier: sex determination, testis and germ cells, and Mullerian tract
name: Sex determination, gonad, germ cell and genital tract development
rationale: Members cover male sex determination, testis (Sertoli, Leydig, AMH), germ cell migration and meiosis entry, and oviduct/uterus/vagina development, which separate it from prostate, ovarian-follicle and placental neighbours.

core: Germline and early embryo epigenetic regulation
qualifier: piRNA retroelement silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Germline piRNA silencing, epigenetic programming and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members share germline/zygote genome and RNA control (piRNA and KRAB/HUSH retroelement silencing, imprinting, protamine exchange, maternal mRNA decay, ZGA), unlike meiotic recombination and fertilization neighbours.

qualifier: muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis, diaphragm
name: Skeletal myogenesis and muscle fiber homeostasis
rationale: Members center on skeletal muscle fiber differentiation, myogenesis, muscle cell homeostasis and diaphragm development, unlike neighbours on atrophy, neuromuscular junction or dystroglycan glycosylation.

qualifier: vascular smooth muscle contraction and cGMP-mediated relaxation
name: Vascular smooth muscle tone regulating systemic blood pressure
rationale: Members regulate arterial pressure via smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, cGMP effects, vasoconstriction and renal sodium excretion; smooth muscle tone distinguishes it from renin-angiotensin and eNOS-activation neighbours.

core: Ascorbate and hydrogen peroxide redox metabolism
qualifier: thyroid hormone generation
name: Ascorbate metabolism, hydrogen peroxide and thyroid hormone generation
rationale: Members combine vitamin C metabolism and transport, H2O2/ROS production and breakdown, and thyroid hormone generation/transport; ascorbate separates it from selenium/thyroid-signalling neighbours and the thyroid/H2O2 members from iron and ROS-detox neighbours.

qualifier: vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation, vitamin E and ubiquinol
name: Vitamin K gamma-carboxylation, vitamin E and ubiquinol metabolism
rationale: Members concern quinone-type lipophilic vitamins: vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation, vitamin E transport/metabolism and ubiquinol synthesis, unlike cholesterol, vitamin C and vitamin D neighbours.

qualifier: Rho GTPase control of filopodia
name: Ephrin signaling and Rho GTPase control of filopodia
rationale: Members are Eph-ephrin signalling, growth cone collapse and RAC1/CDC42/RHOF regulation of filopodia and actin bundles; the Rho GTPase/filopodia members distinguish it from L1, netrin and SLIT-ROBO guidance neighbours.

qualifier: TNF receptor superfamily, canonical and non-canonical (NIK) arms
name: TNF receptor family canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: Members regulate NF-kappaB activity downstream of TNFR1, CD40 and TNFSF receptors including NIK-driven non-canonical signalling and linear ubiquitination, unlike TLR-adaptor and deubiquitinase neighbours.

qualifier: nodal and His-Purkinje cells, gap-junction electrical coupling
name: Cardiac conduction system development and electrical coupling
rationale: All members concern formation of the sinoatrial/atrioventricular nodes, His-Purkinje system and gap-junction coupling for cardiac conduction, unlike vascular and chamber morphogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: monocyte activation and neutrophil-enriched modules
name: Monocyte and neutrophil identity and activation signatures
rationale: Most members are monocyte/macrophage/neutrophil lineage and activation gene modules (one B cell development outlier), distinguished from CSF1-signalling and dendritic-cell/monocyte surface neighbours by monocyte activation and neutrophil modules.

qualifier: formyl peptide receptor chemotaxis and extravasation
name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil chemotaxis and extravasation
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil chemotaxis, migration and diapedesis via formyl peptide receptors, whereas neighbours concern degranulation, respiratory burst or monocyte chemokines.

qualifier: de novo purine and pyrimidine synthesis and NMP/NDP phosphorylation
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine ribonucleotide synthesis and interconversion
rationale: Members are de novo IMP/AMP/GMP and pyrimidine synthesis plus nucleotide phosphorylation to di- and triphosphates, distinct from deoxynucleotide and nucleotide catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: defensins and metal sequestration
name: Defensin and metal-sequestering antimicrobial defense
rationale: Members are direct antimicrobial effector mechanisms (defensins, microbial cytolysis, agglutination, metal/iron sequestration) and the defensin and metal-chelation members separate it from bacterial-attachment and neutrophil-killing neighbours.
